observations: At both desktop sizes the labelled atlas, Relay, Pip, current caption and Pause remain visible; the report below the atlas is reached by ordinary page scroll on short screens.

Room silhouettes and emblems are distinct; compass alignment stays fixed. Beacon uses a solid line and Harbor a dashed line with text labels. Planned route is separate dashed ochre ink, explored marks dotted ink; no automatic location mark.
Narrow atlas intentionally scrolls horizontally inside its labelled region; the page itself has no horizontal overflow. Report quote, freshness and selected-request buttons wrap legibly.
CSS200percent zoom reflows to one column; exact report, stale-condition label and explicit quick-request controls remain readable and keyboard operated.
